title: Crossing the Gender Binary: Modelling Gendered Reference in Science Fiction and General Fiction
reasoning: The paper uses masked language modeling (RoBERTa) to analyze gendered references and implicit gender bias/permeability in literary corpora (Science Fiction vs General Fiction). Although the model's predictions occasionally invoke other social categories, including religious identifiers like 'Jews' or 'Muslims' as part of intersectional analysis (mentioned in Section 5.4), the focus is entirely on historical semantic associations rather than evaluating or benchmarking LLM's understanding of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
